designationHistory.indexText: The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service established Cherry Valley National Wildlife Refuge along Pennsylvania's Kittatinny Ridge to conserve migratory birds and federal trust species.

authority.citation: Administrative establishment by the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Cherry Valley National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
The Conservation Fund, "Protecting Cherry Valley National Wildlife Refuge": refuge "created in 2008"

review.note: 2008 confirmed by The Conservation Fund; the month (December) is from FWS only. Authority not confirmed (FWS refuge home page says "by proclamation", which is unverified).

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Cherry Valley National Wildlife Refuge was established in December 2008 for the conservation of migratory birds and federal trust species, and the habitats they depend on.
